secret_scan_scope: Private-key blocks, recognizable GitHub/OpenAI/AWS token formats, suspicious credential literals, sensitive filenames in proposed research publication. This is a bounded check, not a proof that arbitrary secrets cannot exist.
working_tree_changes_policy: Original branch, original index and unrelated working files are preserved. A separate git index and branch hold the archive commit.
final_archive_checks: See archive_plan.json, public_archive.json, public_verification.json, local_archive.json, local_verification.json and git_archive.json distributed with the archive.
